evals.prompt: I added a new `foreignCurrencySpread` field to our NestJS `CardModel` in `api/src/cards/models/card.model.ts` and queried it in `web/src/modules/cards/queries.ts`, but when I ran `docker compose run --rm web bun run codegen` it failed with `Cannot query field "foreignCurrencySpread" on type "CardModel"`. Should I manually add the field to `api/src/lib/graphql/schema.gql` and `web/src/graphql/generated.ts`?
evals.expected_output: Strictly forbids hand-editing `api/src/lib/graphql/schema.gql` or `web/src/graphql/generated.ts` (the Generated Files Invariant). Explains that frontend codegen reads the local `schema.gql` emitted by the backend, so Stage A (backend schema emission via `docker compose run --rm api bun run generate:dev`) must be executed BEFORE Stage B (frontend codegen via `docker compose run --rm web bun run codegen`). Shows the 4-stage atomic commit split (Stage 1: api resolver/model -> Stage 2: chore(api) generated schema -> Stage 3: web query/component -> Stage 4: chore(web) generated graphql types).
assertions: Strictly forbids manually editing schema.gql or generated frontend GraphQL files
